templates.name: Headline up top
templates.sell: The classic converter: the promise first, the proof right under it. The safe default for shot #1.

templates.name: Screen first
templates.sell: The product leads, the caption lands after — strong when the screen itself is the hook.

templates.name: Full bleed
templates.sell: Immersive, edge-to-edge product with the caption overlaid low. Great for rich, dense screens.

templates.name: Two-line story
templates.sell: Headline plus a supporting subline over a centered device — room to explain a non-obvious win.

templates.name: Editorial
templates.sell: Left-aligned copy like a feature card, device offset to the right — reads premium, stands out in a row of centered sets.

templates.name: Spotlight
templates.sell: One oversized claim with the product beneath it — built for the single number or benefit that sells the app.

templates.name: Full bleed, promise up top
templates.sell: Edge-to-edge product with the caption at the top — where browsing thumbs never cover it.

templates.name: Story after the screen
templates.sell: Device on top, two-line explanation below — the deep-dive frame for shots 3+, after the hook has landed.
